name: @hulala/monorepo
description: Hulala — a local-first DeepSeek Harness workbench and terminal client.

scripts.build: bun run host:build && bun run website:build && bun run --cwd packages/runtime build && bun run --cwd apps/cli build
scripts.check: bun run check:dsh:offline && bun run check:patches && bun run check:changelog && bun run check:wasm && bun run typecheck && bun run test && bun run build
scripts.test: bun test tests/changelog.test.ts tests/checkPatches.test.ts tests/devStart.test.ts tests/dshPin.test.ts tests/installMetadata.test.ts && bun run --cwd apps/server test && bun run --cwd packages/desktop-contracts test && bun run --cwd apps/website test && bun run --cwd packages/runtime test && bun run --cwd packages/host-client test && bun run --cwd apps/cli test
scripts.typecheck: bun run --cwd apps/server typecheck && bun run --cwd packages/desktop-contracts typecheck && bun run --cwd apps/website typecheck && bun run --cwd packages/runtime typecheck && bun run --cwd packages/host-client typecheck && bun run --cwd apps/cli typecheck
